faqs.question: How long is SRU’s agriculture bachelor’s degree?
faqs.answer: The official course page states four years and eight semesters.

faqs.question: Does the programme include rural learning?
faqs.answer: Yes. The course page includes rural work experience and other Student READY elements.

faqs.question: What school subjects are stated for direct entry?
faqs.answer: The programme directory specifies PCB with at least 55% at 10+2.

faqs.question: Is there a diploma route?
faqs.answer: The directory lists a first-class two-year Agriculture or Seed Technology diploma after Class 10.

faqs.question: What is the tuition table’s limitation?
faqs.answer: It displays ₹97,500 per semester but does not explicitly identify the academic year of that table. Obtain a dated confirmation.

faqs.question: Which ICAR term applies to the listed bachelor’s programme?
faqs.answer: The audited record runs from 16 March 2026 to 15 March 2031.

faqs.question: What tuition does SR University publish for agriculture?
faqs.answer: The undated official table lists ₹97,500 per semester for B.Sc. Agriculture, plus separate ₹5,000 enrolment and ₹25,000 one-time admission charges. The governing intake year is unverified; scholarship net fees must not be inferred from inconsistent rounded figures.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at SRU?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. The [courses and fees table](/university/sr-university/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at SRU?
faqs.answer: 4 years. A bachelor’s degree with rural, experiential and industrial learning components.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at SRU?
faqs.answer: Official programme directory: at least 55% in 10+2 with PCB; first-class two-year Agriculture/Seed Technology diploma after Class 10 is also listed.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at SRU?
faqs.answer: ₹97,500 / semester · source undated; current intake not confirmed. Undated official amount; intake-year applicability is not established. Separate table charges: enrolment ₹5,000 and one-time admission ₹25,000. Do not treat this as a current2026–27/2027 payable quote or an all-inclusive attendance cost. Included charges: Tuition only in the published B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture table.

faqs.question: How does admission to SRU work?
faqs.answer: SRU’s programme directory specifies B.Sc. Agriculture entry qualifications. Confirm selection requirements and the academic year of the fee table through the agriculture admissions route. Check the bachelor’s eligibility: Use the B.Sc. Agriculture entry rather than a general engineering or science rule. Confirm fees and scholarship together: Ask for a dated payable statement identifying tuition, enrolment, admission and any concession.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for SRU?
faqs.answer: SR University: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Intake- 120), recorded term 2026-03-16 to 2031-03-15. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at SRU?
faqs.answer: The course page lists RAWE, experiential learning, internships and agro-industrial attachment.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at SRU?
faqs.answer: Instructional farm and horticulture garden: The course page identifies these as settings for field learning. Agriculture laboratories: The university describes laboratories supporting experiential study.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for SRU?
faqs.answer: The course page identifies instructional farm and horticulture resources, and explicitly describes Student READY learning components. Accommodation availability, meal charges and transport arrangements for your entry year still need direct confirmation.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for SRU?
faqs.answer: SRU publishes an agriculture-specific tuition scholarship table with board and entrance-score categories. Its applicability and academic-year coverage need written confirmation; the separate April 2026 early-admission promotion has already passed. B.Sc. Agriculture merit scholarship table: The official page displays different tuition concessions according to qualifying scores and examinations. The draft does not assign an award to any applicant.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for SRU?
faqs.answer: SRU’s agriculture admissions material describes industry connections, skills and career guidance. A dated bachelor’s placement cohort, salary or recruiter report was not verified.

faqs.question: How can I contact SRU about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: +91 8331004040. Published email: info@sru.edu.in. Official admissions: https://sru.edu.in/admissions-2026/agriculture

faqs.question: Which dated admission notices are recorded for SRU?
faqs.answer: No dated admission event is verified in this profile. The official channel is https://sru.edu.in/admissions-2026/agriculture; check the notice for the programme and entry year you intend to join.
